Title: Public preview: Free managed TLS certificates for Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps now supports managed certificates. This feature is in public preview.

Managed certificates are free and enable you to automatically provision and renew TLS certificates for any custom domain you add to your container app.

To learn more, see Free managed certificates in Azure Container Apps: https://aka.ms/containerapps/managed-certificates
